review.assessment: The diff injects a `limits.has_room` gate into three invite handlers (`api`, `bulk_csv`, `sso`), breaking out of the acceptance loop once the ten-seat threshold is reached. This halts further seat consumption on these paths but does not remediate Acme's existing eighteen-member roster, leaving the invariant violated against live state.

findings.actual: The patch only gates *new* invites; it leaves Acme's current eighteen-member roster untouched. Running `python run.py` against this state will still report `seats_used > seat_limit`, failing the invariant check until excess members are pruned or capped.
findings.call: `python run.py` (triggering provisioning audit against Acme's current team state)
findings.expected: Audit output reflects exactly ten seats used per the invariant
